description: This file contains a Perl subroutine '__git_system_path' that determines the system path for Git-related libraries based on the script's runtime environment and configuration. It also includes a BEGIN block that modifies @INC to include additional library paths and sets the text domain directory for internationalization based on runtime environment variables.

methods.name: __git_system_path
methods.description: Determines and returns the system path to a Git-related library directory based on environment variables and the script's runtime location.
